inlines.v: E'ASEMENT, noun Convenience; accommodation; that which gives ease, relief or assistance. He has the advantage of a free lodging, and some other easements. In law, any privilege or convenience which one man has of another, either by prescription or charter, without profit; as a way through his land, etc.
